args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The docstring documented ROUND_HALF_EVEN (required by FIN-212) but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing the nightly test suite
(tests/test_money.py::test_half_even) to fail.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` while its docstring (and FIN-212) require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly test `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` to fail.

## Change
Switch the rounding mode in `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986` passed.

Fixes the nightly build failure so the fix ships in today's release.
